name: Queen on Fire
source:
A medieval game about a Queen who will be put to the flame. You, the player, will choose her choices!

[From [url=https://miss-pharos.itch.io/queen-on-fire-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
這款遊戲講述一位中世紀女王即將被處以火刑的故事。她會怎麼做？每個選擇都由你來做！

［摘自[url=https://miss-pharos.itch.io/queen-on-fire-demo]itch.io[/url]］
